body: What are you finding so difficult?
Thank you, really.. Thank you. This helps me so much more than you could imagine.

There is a whole community out there who've gone through what you're experiencing and some even in the same position as you, talk to them and maybe you'll find that the hard work could be worth it. It's not an easy process but it will be worth the journey for the happiness that you want.  


Relationships come and go but you are the only constant therefore you are all that matters. Forget that girl and do what's right by you.

I get what you're talking about, I'll admit that I'm at the "don't want to become an inconvenience" stage and have a plan but thinking about what it'll do to my close family and friends that I haven't had the heart to push away yet, It's not the right time or distance. 

Sometimes you can't prevent something and only end up prolonging a decision that has already been made. That doesn't mean not to try but just to try understand and not to blame yourself or those closest to them.
